column1: # Raw records (no resampling) in Long S4D / Long Mamba, 10/17. Li-ion only, readout + R_FIRST, geo_bins, 3 seeds.
# Code: data_provider/data_loader_raw.py (every logged record of cycles 1..100, rests kept, 4 channels V/I/Qc/Qd,
#   tau = real step to the previous record / DT_C, across cycle boundaries too), LongMamba --long_raw (flat sequence +
#   cycle ids, tokens at cycle starts). Tests: test_raw.py (train_eval_scripts/test_raw_qsub.sh) -- run first.
# Arms: const = same raw records, tau = 1 per record (clock ignored); real = recorded clock. Compare real vs const, and
#   both vs the 300-point grid runs (S4D 0.203 / tdtconst 0.208 / tdtreal 0.261; Mamba tdtconst 0.260 / tdtreal 0.260).
# DT_C=5: the logging interval of MATR / HUST / ISU-ILCC / Stanford (most Li-ion cells), so tau = 1 for them; XJTU 0.2,
#   SNL / UL-PUR 24 (120 s). DT_CLIP=100 (500 s) only cuts non-logging pauses, never a logging interval. Check the
#   '[raw train] ... at clip' line in the log / test_raw.qlog.
# Lengths: ~8k (SNL) .. ~690k (XJTU) steps per 100-cycle sample. BATCH=8 max samples, BATCH_STEPS=600000 per batch,
#   GRAD_CKPT=1. H_RT is a guess (~5x the grid runs' steps per epoch); check s/iter in the first log.
